environment.description: Kubernetes CronJob running in shared analytics namespace. MongoDB 6.0 Community Edition with authentication enabled. The CLI service account connects with readWrite role on the 'analytics' database. No MongoDB views or query validation rules configured. TENANT_OVERRIDE=1 is set in the pod environment for debugging purposes (leftover from staging migration). The usage_events collection contains data for all tenants in a single collection with tenant_id field.
